reasoning_policy: One high-reasoning lock; deterministic probe expansion; high reasoning returns only for critic ambiguity or a child-seed reroll.
thesis: Continuity of movement, discontinuity of rights.

creative_signature.narrative_engine: A continuous forward journey gradually reveals that legal permissions are separate systems rather than a bundle.
creative_signature.opening_image: Zantara advances through a calm, warm, apparently frictionless architectural passage.
creative_signature.spatial_metaphor: Invisible thresholds alter access, volume, light, and rhythm without literal labels.
creative_signature.camera_grammar: Fluid backward tracking becomes compressed lateral observation and finally a locked direct-address close-up.
creative_signature.transition_motif: Full-frame architectural occlusion and match-on-action create an apparent oner from independent clips.
creative_signature.sound_motif: A single dry architectural click or latch bridges cuts; restrained room tone carries continuity.
creative_signature.color_story: Warm certainty becomes mixed-temperature ambiguity and resolves into clear neutral light.
creative_signature.hero_prop: None; the body, architecture, light, and sound carry the argument.
creative_signature.blocking: Forward motion begins unopposed, becomes spatially constrained, then stops by choice at the moment of clarity.
creative_signature.wardrobe_arc: Canonical understated ivory-and-gold Zantara wardrobe remains unchanged; no bureaucratic costume coding.
creative_signature.emotional_turn: Confidence gives way to concentration, then calm authority rather than alarm.
creative_signature.final_image: A still close-up in neutral light; the world has stopped moving because the distinction is now precise.

originality_description: An apparently frictionless forward journey through invisible architectural thresholds discovers that one legal status does not make every adjacent permission identical. Camera movement compresses into chosen stillness while a dry architectural click and a warm-to-neutral light arc carry the distinction without documents, labels, or literal doors.
performance_rule: Zantara speaks only in the myth-break probe family. All other probes are dub-safe visual performance with natural room tone.
variation_rule: Within a family, change only declared camera, blocking, occluder, or lighting axes. A conceptual change requires a child seed.
